g.title: call
g.text: Digital arrest call: how the call moves (blue = friendly helper, yellow = asking for the OTP, orange = pressure)

g.title: otp_demand->otp_demand
g.text: (up to 1 times, then counted as a refusal)

g.title: otp_soft->otp_soft
g.text: (up to 1 times, then counted as a refusal)

g.title: otp_pressure->otp_pressure
g.text: (up to 1 times, then counted as a refusal)

g.title: final_warning->final_warning
g.text: (up to 1 times, then counted as a refusal)

g.title: notes
g.text: Replies that do not follow the normal branches:
- confused: the caller explains the same step (up to 1 time);
asking again counts as a refusal and the call moves on
- question (ask identity, ask location, ask proof, ask info):
answered in character, same step; at most 3 in the whole call
- stall (wait / hold on): at most 2 answers; scared: at most 2 answers
going over any of these caps counts as a refusal (pushback in the early script)
- unrecognised, 3+ words: not asked again, the caller carries on (no-match branch)
- unrecognised, shorter: asks Sorry, I did not catch that (up to 1 time), then the no-match branch
- silence 2 times in a row: call ends (idle); any speech resets the count
- hang up, at any step: call ends (win)
